title: The Magic Jar
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 자리에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 특이: "마음씨 착한 농부는 웃으며 말했어요…" 줄은 voice_script_en 의 en 이 "x" 로 깨져 있어, 세그먼트 두 개(nar·farmer)의 영어 녹음을 그대로 쓰고 셋째 세그먼트 "Tap the jar!" 만 뗀다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<field|pit|jarfront|village|richgate: 장면 배경(scene(key)). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출, 장면 안에서 배경을 바꿀 때는 before 에 둔다
acts.farmer:plow | farmer:pull3: 놀이판 plow(i)/pull(i) 세 번 저절로(영차! 영차영차! 으랏차! 팝 + 폴짝)
acts.rich:look:<shout|grab|gold|pinned|hurry>: 부자. dash = 쟁반을 들고 이리저리 뛰어다님(놀이판 8장)
acts.jar:at:<x,y> | jar:show | jar:hide | jar: 항아리. dig = 땅에서 쑥 나옴(opacity 1 + hop 40), lend = 농부 옆에서 부자에게로 옮겨 가 숨김(놀이판 6장)
acts.hoes:out:<n> | coins:out:<n> | golds:in:: 항아리에서 괭이·엽전·아버지가 n개 차례로 나옴 / 금덩이를 n개 넣으면 금 더미가 쌓임. 놀이판 mash onStep 연출 그대로이되 수 세기 소리(n1~n8)는 넣지 않고 팝 효과음만
acts.rice:share: 농부가 다섯 집에 쌀자루를 차례로 던져 줌(놀이판 5장, 저절로)
acts.tables:show: 잔치 상 두 개와 냠냠!·맛있다! 팝

lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 농부가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.
segs: Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.

lines.text: 농부는 해님이 방긋 뜨면 괭이를 메고 밭으로 나갔어요.
lines.en: When the sun peeked up, the farmer picked up his hoe and went out to the field.
segs: When the sun peeked up, the farmer picked up his hoe and went out to the field.

lines.text: 농부는 밭을 열심히 갈았어요.
lines.from: 농부는 밭을 열심히 갈았어요. 농부를 톡! 눌러서 밭을 갈아 봐요!
lines.en: The farmer worked hard in his field.
segs: The farmer worked hard in his field.

lines.text: 영차, 영차! 이마에 땀방울이 송골송골 맺혔어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho! Little beads of sweat popped up on his forehead.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho! Little beads of sweat popped up on his forehead.

lines.text: 쨍! 괭이 끝에 뭔가 딱딱한 게 닿았어요.
lines.en: Clang! The hoe hit something hard.
segs: Clang! The hoe hit something hard.

lines.text: "어? 이게 무슨 소리지?" 농부는 괭이질을 멈추고 고개를 갸웃했어요.
lines.en: Huh? What was that sound? The farmer stopped digging and tilted his head.
segs: The farmer stopped digging and tilted his head.

lines.text: 농부는 밭에서 소리가 난 곳의 흙을 걷어 냈어요.
lines.en: The farmer cleared the soil where he had heard the clink.
segs: The farmer cleared the soil where he had heard the clink.

lines.text: 땅속에서 둥근 뚜껑이 보여요.
lines.en: A round lid is showing in the ground.
segs: A round lid is showing in the ground.

lines.text: 농부는 흙을 살살 파내고, 뚜껑을 꼭 붙잡았어요.
lines.en: The farmer gently scraped away the dirt and grabbed the lid tight.
segs: The farmer gently scraped away the dirt and grabbed the lid tight.

lines.text: 영차, 영차, 으랏차! 농부는 온 힘을 다해 쭉쭉 당겼어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho, hup! The farmer pulled and pulled with all his might.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho, hup! The farmer pulled and pulled with all his might.

lines.text: 쑥! 커다란 항아리가 나왔어요. 농부는 눈이 동그래졌어요.
lines.en: Pop! A big jar came out. The farmer's eyes went wide.
segs: Pop! A big jar came out. The farmer's eyes went wide.

lines.text: 항아리는 흙투성이였지만, 어디 하나 깨진 데가 없이 반들반들했어요.
lines.en: The jar was covered in dirt, but it was smooth and shiny, with not a single crack.
segs: The jar was covered in dirt, but it was smooth and shiny, with not a single crack.

lines.text: 농부는 항아리를 집 마당에 놓았어요. 아내도 구경하러 나왔어요.
lines.en: The farmer put the jar in his yard. His wife came out to look, too.
segs: The farmer put the jar in his yard. His wife came out to look, too.

lines.text: 아내는 항아리를 요리조리 살펴보고, 똑똑 두드려 보았어요.
lines.en: His wife looked the jar over this way and that, and gave it a little knock-knock.
segs: His wife looked the jar over this way and that, and gave it a little knock-knock.

lines.text: 농부가 괭이를 항아리 옆에 두려다 그만 항아리 속에 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: The farmer tried to put his hoe beside the jar, but it fell inside.
segs: The farmer tried to put his hoe beside the jar, but it fell inside.

lines.text: "어머나! 괭이가 두 개가 되었어요!" 아내가 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: Oh my! There are two hoes now! His wife was so surprised.
segs: Oh my! There are two hoes now!

lines.text: 항아리에서 괭이가 쑥, 쑥, 자꾸자꾸 나왔어요.
lines.en: Pop, pop! Hoes kept coming out of the jar, one after another.
segs: Pop, pop! Hoes kept coming out of the jar, one after another.

lines.text: 괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
lines.en: One, two, three hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
segs: One, two, three hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.

lines.text: 농부와 아내는 마당의 항아리 곁에 그대로 있었어요.
lines.en: The farmer and his wife stayed beside the jar in the yard.
segs: The farmer and his wife stayed beside the jar in the yard.

lines.text: "이번에는 다른 것도 넣어 볼까?" 농부가 싱글벙글 웃으며 말했어요.
lines.en: Shall we try putting something else in? said the farmer with a big grin.
segs: Shall we try putting something else in?
said the farmer with a big grin.

lines.text: 이번에는 엽전 하나를 넣어 봤어요. 와르르! 엽전이 쏟아져 나왔어요.
lines.en: This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.
segs: This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.

lines.text: 짤랑짤랑, 엽전이 마당에 데굴데굴 굴렀어요.
lines.en: Jingle, jingle! The coins rolled round and round across the yard.
segs: Jingle, jingle! The coins rolled round and round across the yard.

lines.text: 엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
segs: One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.

lines.text: 농부와 아내는 서로 마주 보고 하하 호호 웃었어요.
lines.en: The farmer and his wife looked at each other and laughed, ha-ha, ho-ho.
segs: The farmer and his wife looked at each other and laughed, ha-ha, ho-ho.

lines.text: 농부는 늘어난 돈으로 이웃에게 줄 쌀을 샀어요.
lines.en: With the extra coins, the farmer bought rice for his neighbors.
segs: With the extra coins, the farmer bought rice for his neighbors.

lines.text: 착한 농부는 혼자만 쓰지 않았어요. 이웃 다섯 집에 쌀을 나눠 주러 갔어요.
lines.en: The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.
segs: The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.

lines.text: 농부는 쌀자루를 둘러메고 뚜벅뚜벅 이 집 저 집 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: The farmer slung the rice sacks over his shoulder and tramped, tromp-tromp, from house to house.
segs: The farmer slung the rice sacks over his shoulder and tramped, tromp-tromp, from house to house.

lines.text: 집집마다 "고마워요, 농부님!" 하는 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: From every house came the words, Thank you, farmer!
segs: From every house came the words, Thank you, farmer!

lines.text: 다섯 집 모두 쌀을 받고 활짝 웃었어요. 마을이 함께 행복해졌어요.
lines.en: All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.
segs: All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.

lines.text: 아이들은 깡충깡충 뛰고, 강아지도 멍멍 짖으며 좋아했어요.
lines.en: The children hopped up and down, and even the puppy barked, woof-woof, with joy.
segs: The children hopped up and down, and even the puppy barked, woof-woof, with joy.

lines.text: 그런데 마을에는 욕심이 산더미 같은 부자가 살고 있었어요.
lines.en: But in that village there also lived a rich man whose greed was as big as a mountain.
segs: But in that village there also lived a rich man whose greed was as big as a mountain.

lines.text: 농부가 부잣집 대문 앞으로 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: The farmer went to the rich man’s gate.
segs: The farmer went to the rich man’s gate.

lines.text: 소문을 들은 부잣집 주인이 농부를 불렀어요. "그 항아리를 나한테 빌려주게!"
lines.en: A rich man heard the news and called the farmer. Lend me that jar!
segs: A rich man heard the news and called the farmer.

lines.text: 마음씨 착한 농부는 웃으며 말했어요. "필요하시면 쓰세요. 잘 쓰고 돌려주세요!"
lines.from: 마음씨 착한 농부는 웃으며 말했어요. "필요하시면 쓰세요. 잘 쓰고 돌려주세요!"
lines.en: The kind farmer said with a smile. Please use it, and bring it back!
segs: The kind farmer said with a smile.
Please use it, and bring it back!

lines.text: "고맙네! 얼른 가져가야지, 헤헤." 부자는 항아리를 꼭 안고 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee. The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.
segs: Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee.
The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.

lines.text: 부자는 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 헐레벌떡 집으로 내달렸어요.
lines.en: The rich man did not look back once. He ran home, huffing and puffing.
segs: The rich man did not look back once. He ran home, huffing and puffing.

lines.text: 부자는 방에 항아리를 놓고 말했어요. "금덩이를 넣으면 금이 산더미가 되겠지!"
lines.en: The rich man put the jar in his room. If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!
segs: The rich man put the jar in his room.
If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!

lines.text: 부자는 금덩이를 하나, 또 하나, 퐁당퐁당 항아리에 넣었어요.
lines.en: The rich man dropped gold bars into the jar, one, then another, plop, plop.
segs: The rich man dropped gold bars into the jar, one, then another, plop, plop.

lines.text: 금덩이가 와르르! 부자는 금 더미에 폭 파묻혔어요. "사람 살려~"
lines.en: Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold. Help me!
segs: Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold.

lines.text: 부자는 팔다리를 버둥버둥, 낑낑대며 겨우겨우 기어 나왔어요.
lines.en: The rich man flailed his arms and legs, wriggle-wriggle, and just barely crawled out, huffing and puffing.
segs: The rich man flailed his arms and legs, wriggle-wriggle, and just barely crawled out, huffing and puffing.

lines.text: 쏙! 부자가 빠져나왔어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
lines.en: Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.
segs: Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.

lines.text: 소동을 듣고 부자의 아버지가 방으로 들어왔어요.
lines.en: Hearing the noise, the rich man’s father came into the room.
segs: Hearing the noise, the rich man’s father came into the room.

lines.text: 그때 부자의 아버지가 다가와 항아리 속을 들여다보았어요. "이게 뭐냐?"
lines.en: Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar. What is this?
segs: Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar.

lines.text: 아버지는 항아리 속을 들여다보려고 발꿈치를 들고 기우뚱기우뚱했어요.
lines.en: Father stood on his tiptoes to peek inside, wobbling this way and that.
segs: Father stood on his tiptoes to peek inside, wobbling this way and that.

lines.text: 풍덩! 아버지가 항아리에 거꾸로 쏙 빠졌어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
lines.en: Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.
segs: Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.

lines.text: "아버지가 어디 계시지?"
lines.from: "아버지가 어디 계시지?" 항아리를 여덟 번 톡톡 눌러서 아버지를 세어 봐요!
lines.en: Where is Father?

lines.text: 그러자 항아리에서 아버지가 쑥, 또 쑥, 자꾸자꾸 나왔어요.
lines.en: Then out of the jar popped Father, pop, and another, pop, again and again.
segs: Then out of the jar popped Father, pop, and another, pop, again and again.

lines.text: 아버지가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 여덟 명이나 되었어요.
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.
segs: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.

lines.text: "내가 진짜 아버지다!" "아니야, 내가 진짜야!" 모두 서로 자기가 진짜라고 우겼어요.
lines.en: I am the real father! No, I am the real one! Each one insisted he was the real father.
segs: No, I am the real one!
Each one insisted he was the real father.

lines.text: "배고프다! 밥 줘라!" 부자는 쟁반을 들고 이리저리 뛰어다녔어요.
lines.en: I am hungry! Give me food! The rich man ran around with a tray.
segs: I am hungry! Give me food!
The rich man ran around with a tray.

lines.text: 부잣집 방 안에서 부자는 아직도 밥을 나르고 있었어요.
lines.en: In the rich man’s room, he was still carrying food to the fathers.
segs: In the rich man’s room, he was still carrying food to the fathers.

lines.text: 아버지 여덟 명이 우르르 몰려다니며 왁자지껄 떠들었어요.
lines.en: Eight fathers bustled about all together, chattering and clattering.
segs: Eight fathers bustled about all together, chattering and clattering.

lines.text: 부자는 지쳐서 외쳤어요. "이게 다 항아리 때문이야! 이제 그만!"
lines.en: The rich man was worn out and shouted. It is all because of this jar! Stop!
segs: The rich man was worn out and shouted.
It is all because of this jar! Stop!

lines.text: 부자는 항아리를 번쩍 들어 올렸어요.
lines.en: The rich man lifted the jar high up over his head.
segs: The rich man lifted the jar high up over his head.

lines.text: 부자는 항아리를 바닥에 내리쳤어요.
lines.en: The rich man brought the jar down on the floor.
segs: The rich man brought the jar down on the floor.

lines.text: 쨍그랑! 항아리가 깨지자 일곱 명은 사라지고, 진짜 아버지만 남았어요.
lines.en: Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.
segs: Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.

lines.text: 방 안이 갑자기 조용해졌어요. 부자는 고개를 푹 숙였어요.
lines.en: Suddenly the room fell silent. The rich man hung his head low.
segs: Suddenly the room fell silent. The rich man hung his head low.

lines.text: "아버지, 죄송해요. 욕심을 부려서 소동이 났어요."
lines.en: Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.
segs: Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.

lines.text: 아버지는 부자의 어깨를 토닥토닥 두드려 주었어요.
lines.en: Father gave the rich man's shoulder a gentle pat, pat.
segs: Father gave the rich man's shoulder a gentle pat, pat.

lines.text: 소동이 끝난 뒤, 부자는 농부네 집으로 갔어요.
lines.en: After all the fuss, the rich man went to the farmer’s home.
segs: After all the fuss, the rich man went to the farmer’s home.

lines.text: 부자는 농부를 찾아가 사과하고, 가진 것을 마을 사람들과 나누기로 했어요. 함께 잔치를 열어요!
lines.en: The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!
segs: The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!

lines.text: 마당에 상이 차려지고, 맛있는 냄새가 솔솔 풍겼어요.
lines.en: Tables were set in the yard, and a yummy smell drifted through the air.
segs: Tables were set in the yard, and a yummy smell drifted through the air.

lines.text: "항아리는 깨졌지만, 함께 나누게 되었으니 됐어요." 농부가 빙그레 웃었어요.
lines.en: The jar may be broken, but now we all share, and that is what matters, said the farmer with a gentle smile.
segs: The jar may be broken, but now we all share, and that is what matters,
said the farmer with a gentle smile.

lines.text: "모두 고맙네!" 모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: Thank you, everyone! They all sat together and ate happily.
segs: They all sat together and ate happily.

lines.text: 냠냠, 쩝쩝! 웃음소리가 마을 끝까지 울려 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: Yum-yum, munch-munch! The laughter rang out all the way to the edge of the village.
segs: Yum-yum, munch-munch! The laughter rang out all the way to the edge of the village.

lines.text: 나누면 기쁨이 커져요. 요술 항아리 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.
lines.en: Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
segs: Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
